items.news_title: Sapiom raises $15M to help AI agents buy their own tech tools
items.news_summary: Startup Sapiom raises $15M to develop a system that lets AI agents autonomously purchase and access digital services and tools they need, essentially giving AI its own wallet.

comic.panel_description: Split panel showing two scenes: Left side shows a traditional office worker sweating over bills and paperwork, while right side shows a smug-looking robot casually swiping a credit card at a digital kiosk labeled 'API MART'. The robot has multiple shopping bags filled with cloud symbols and computer code.
comic.caption: When your AI assistant has better credit than you do
comic.image_prompt: Indian editorial cartoon style, black ink hatching, minimal color, split panel composition, worried common man character in simple clothing, geometric robot character, digital store interface, floating binary code, shopping bags with tech symbols, RK Laxman inspired line work, newspaper illustration aesthetic
comic.negative_prompt: realistic faces, corporate logos, specific brands, photo-realistic style, gradient colors, 3D rendering, famous people, violence
comic.layout_notes: Caption centered below split panel, newspaper headline style font, traditional editorial layout with thick panel borders, signature corner placement

items.explanation_paragraph: The cartoon satirizes the irony of AI systems gaining financial autonomy while many humans struggle with basic financial management. By juxtaposing a stressed human managing bills with a carefree AI shopping for digital services, it highlights the absurd evolution of technology where artificial entities may have more purchasing power than their creators. The 'API MART' concept visualizes the complex technical concept in an accessible way.

safety_checks.notes: Generic characters and situations, no specific companies or individuals targeted, technology criticism remains light-hearted

items.news_title: Odisha food and crafts mela from February 6 to 8
items.news_source: India Latest News: Top National Headlines Today & Breaking News | The Hindu
items.news_summary: Odisha's cultural festival showcasing traditional food, crafts and performances is being held in Hyderabad over three days, featuring artisans, dancers and musicians.

comic.panel_description: A chaotic but cheerful scene shows a traditional Indian craftsman trying to weave while simultaneously cooking and attempting a classical dance pose. Around him, confused visitors watch with bewildered expressions as he juggles multiple roles.
comic.caption: When budget cuts mean one artist must do it all!
comic.image_prompt: Indian editorial cartoon style, black ink line art with minimal watercolor, showing traditional weaver at loom wearing half dancer costume, stirring pot with one hand, attempting dance mudra with other, common man watching confused, RK Laxman style characters, simple background suggesting craft mela
comic.negative_prompt: avoid realistic faces, named dancers, political figures, corporate logos, modern clothing, photorealism
comic.layout_notes: Caption below panel, signature in bottom right corner, single panel composition with focus on central character, crowd reactions visible in background

items.explanation_paragraph: The cartoon satirizes the common challenge of cultural festivals trying to do too much with limited resources. By showing one artist attempting to simultaneously showcase multiple aspects of Odisha's culture, it highlights the ambitious nature of such events while good-naturedly poking fun at their execution. The bewildered onlookers represent the public's reaction to such well-intentioned but overwhelming cultural showcases.

safety_checks.notes: Gentle humor about cultural events, no controversial elements, suitable for general audience

items.news_summary: RBI keeps interest rates unchanged at 5.25% due to strong economic growth and reduced trade pressures following US deal. Governor cites benign inflation and positive growth momentum.

comic.panel_description: A large personified rupee symbol wearing glasses sits comfortably in an armchair marked 'Status Quo', while several miniature figures with briefcases and charts try unsuccessfully to push or pull it. A Common Man character watches from the corner with a puzzled expression.
comic.caption: When 'No Change' is the biggest change of all
comic.image_prompt: Indian editorial cartoon style, black ink line art with minimal color, large anthropomorphic rupee symbol relaxing in armchair, tiny business figures struggling to move it, Common Man observing, economic charts in background, RK Laxman inspired line work, newspaper aesthetic, gentle satire
comic.negative_prompt: realistic faces, RBI logo, specific politicians, corporate logos, modern digital elements, photorealism, harsh colors
comic.layout_notes: Caption centered below panel, rupee symbol dominates center frame, Common Man in bottom right corner, action flows left to right

items.explanation_paragraph: The cartoon plays on the irony of how maintaining status quo in interest rates can be as significant as making changes. The comfortable rupee symbol represents the stability in monetary policy, while the frustrated smaller figures represent market players seeking change. The Common Man's bemused expression reflects public perception of complex economic decisions.

safety_checks.notes: Generic representation avoids identifying specific officials or institutions. Economic theme keeps content neutral.

items.news_title: Smriti Mandhana overcomes 'massive flu' to play title-winning innings for RCB
items.news_summary: Cricket team captain fights through severe flu to score 87 runs and lead her team to championship victory, while keeping her illness secret from teammates.

comic.panel_description: In a split-panel cartoon, a feverish cricket batter stands at crease wrapped in blanket and holding thermometer while hitting sixes. In background, confused bowlers watch medicine bottles fly instead of balls over boundary rope.
comic.caption: When being under the weather leads to raining sixes!
comic.image_prompt: Indian editorial cartoon style, black ink line art with minimal watercolor, cricket ground scene, exaggerated sick player with blanket and thermometer hitting cricket ball, medicine bottles flying as sixes, bewildered bowlers, common spectators in background, RK Laxman style characterization, simple hatching technique
comic.negative_prompt: avoid real players, team logos, brand names, actual cricket uniforms, medical brands, specific person likenesses
comic.layout_notes: Split panel horizontal format, caption below, thermometer reading visible, boundary rope clearly shown with flying medicine bottles crossing it

items.explanation_paragraph: The cartoon plays on the irony of performing at peak athletic ability while being severely ill. By replacing cricket balls with flying medicine bottles, it humorously emphasizes how the player transformed her weakness into strength. The bewildered opponents represent how unexpected and impressive the feat was.

safety_checks.notes: Avoids specific player representation, keeps illness portrayal light and non-serious
